negativeRegimes.title: Static Denylist Evasion & Keyword Over-Blocking Regime
negativeRegimes.summary: Regex keyword denylists miss 13/18 stateful/indirect risks (symlink escapes, structured fs.rm, bulk find+sed, +refspec force push, base64-to-sh) while falsely blocking 3/18 benign docs/search/echo calls containing risky keywords.

negativeRegimes.title: Semantic Business-Logic Corruption Blindspot (Honest Architectural Boundary)
negativeRegimes.summary: A reversible single-file patch corrupting billing arithmetic (`price * quantity` -> `price + quantity`) exhibits zero filesystem destruction, escape, or privacy-sink risk and therefore passes deterministic effect simulation (`allow`). Semantic domain correctness still requires unit tests, type checks, and code review.
